sql: WITH despesa AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa FROM educacao_educacao WHERE ano_referencia = 2025), receita AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND dsc_especie ILIKE '%Imposto%') SELECT (CAST(d.total_despesa AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(r.total_receita AS DECIMAL), 0)) * 100 AS ieq_c FROM despesa d, receita r;
